name: sessionplane
description: Durable local runtime for role-addressed browser-backed AI chat sessions

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/release-preflight.mjs --emit-build-identity
scripts.test: npm run test:ci && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:ci: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --experimental-strip-types test/integration/public-cli.test.ts test/integration/public-task-rpc.test.ts test/integration/offline-state-rehearsal.test.ts test/integration/live-task-acceptance.test.ts test/integration/live-candidate-preflight.test.ts test/integration/health-rpc.test.ts test/unit/backend-recovery.test.ts test/unit/durable-task-kernel.test.ts test/unit/managed-continuation.test.ts test/unit/semantic-decision-gateway.test.ts test/unit/semantic-exact-task-port.test.ts test/unit/semantic-provider-registry.test.ts test/unit/owned-page-runtime.test.ts test/unit/mcp-tools.test.ts
scripts.test:acceptance: npm run test:ci && npm run test:browser && npm run test:package
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run doctor
